title: Monitoring of AI tools in clinical practice: Usage, performance, and impact on the diagnostic workflow
summary: In this study, the use and performance of various AI tools in clinical practice will be evaluated. Additionally, the impact of AI results on the diagnostic workflow in radiology will be assessed.
conditions: Handling of AI tools in the reporting process

interventions.name: This prospective, single-center study evaluates the use and performance of various CE-certified AI tools in routine radiological practice.
